# Levain

A levain is the portion of starter that a baker feeds some hours before a bake, so that it is at its peak when it goes into the dough ([[Bread book (source)]]). A ripe levain domes and smells sweet rather than sharp ([[Bread book (source)]]). It is the heart of [[Sourdough]].
